papers.title: Additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V/Ta bimetal: from neutron diffraction residual stress analysis to wear and bioproperty testings
papers.abstract: Powder bed fusion-laser beam prepared Ti-6Al-4V/Ta bimetals can be well-suited for advanced biomedical applications. However, a few issues remain unsolved, including (a) understanding of residual stress distribution and its level in as-printed bimetal; and (b) wear and bio properties of the bimetal. This study aims to address these points through a series of investigations, including residual stress analysis by neutron diffraction, printing optimization, and analysis of heat treatment effect on the properties. It was discovered that the residual stress is highly related to the temperature gradient and Young’s modulus. In the interface region of the as-printed bimetal, the residual stress was reduced and inverted compared to the as-printed Ta alone, changing from ~ (140-180) MPa (tensile) to ~ (30-70) MPa (compressive), which may have helped the Ta layer bond effectively with the Ti-6Al-4V matrix. Meanwhile, a high residual stress (~ 390 MPa) in the Ti-6Al-4V part of the as-printed bimetal justifies the need for heat treatment. After heat treatment, the bimetal exhibited good biocompatibility and much improved wear and corrosion resistance compared to Ti-6Al-4V alone. These improvements may be attributed to the formation of tantalum oxide during friction and corrosion processes. Ta layer can also improve the biocompatibility due to its intrinsic noncytotoxic feature.

llm.relevance_to_user: 论文涉及Ti-6Al-4V/Ta双金属的热处理工艺，但主要关注双金属而非纯Ti-6Al-4V的后处理对疲劳性能的影响。
llm.why_not_core: Paper focuses on bimetal Ti-6Al-4V/Ta and does not isolate the post-processing effect on Ti-6Al-4V alone; no explicit fatigue testing is performed.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究激光粉末床熔融制备的Ti-6Al-4V/Ta双金属中残余应力分布及后处理影响
summary_zh.method: 通过中子衍射分析残余应力，结合热处理优化双金属性能
summary_zh.result: 热处理后双金属的耐磨性和生物相容性优于纯Ti-6Al-4V
summary_zh.validation: 采用中子衍射和磨损实验验证残余应力及性能改善

summary_en.motivation: To investigate residual stress distribution and the effect of heat treatment on the properties of additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V/Ta bimetal for biomedical applications.
summary_en.method: Neutron diffraction residual stress analysis and heat treatment optimization were performed on laser powder bed fused Ti-6Al-4V/Ta bimetals.
summary_en.result: Heat treatment improved wear and corrosion resistance while maintaining good biocompatibility, attributed to tantalum oxide formation.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation included neutron diffraction for residual stress and wear/corrosion tests for mechanical and bio-properties.

papers.title: Thermo-hydrogen processing of Ti-6Al-4V alloy: Recent perspectives on sustainable powder production and additive manufacturing

llm.relevance_to_user: 该文章综述了热氢处理在Ti-6Al-4V粉末生产及增材制造中的可持续性应用，但未涉及力学或疲劳性能。
llm.why_not_core: This is a review on powder production and processing, not providing new mechanical/fatigue characterization or modeling of Ti-6Al-4V.

summary_zh.motivation: 综述热氢处理在Ti-6Al-4V粉末生产与增材制造中的研究进展
summary_zh.result: 总结了热氢处理在可持续粉末制备和增材制造中的应用现状与前景
summary_zh.validation: 无实验验证，为综述文章

summary_en.motivation: This review summarizes recent perspectives on thermo-hydrogen processing for sustainable powder production and additive manufacturing of Ti-6Al-4V.
summary_en.method: A comprehensive literature review of thermo-hydrogen processing techniques applied to Ti-6Al-4V.
summary_en.result: The paper outlines current developments and future prospects in utilizing thermo-hydrogen processing for powder synthesis and AM of Ti-6Al-4V.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation; the work is a review of existing literature.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究对象为废旧轧制Ti-6Al-4V棒材，与增材制造无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper studies scrap-rolled (wrought) Ti-6Al-4V bars, not additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V, so it does not address the mechanical/fatigue performance of AM Ti-6Al-4V as required by Layer 1.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究退火温度对废旧轧制Ti-6Al-4V合金棒材组织与性能的影响。
summary_zh.method: 对废旧轧制棒材进行不同温度退火处理，并测试其力学性能。
summary_zh.result: 退火温度显著影响显微组织和力学性能。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of annealing temperature on the microstructure and mechanical properties of scrap-rolled Ti-6Al-4V alloy bars.
summary_en.method: Scrap-rolled bars were annealed at various temperatures and then characterized microstructurally and mechanically.
summary_en.result: Annealing temperature significantly influences the microstructure and resulting mechanical behavior.
summary_en.validation: Experimental testing was performed to validate the findings.
